subject: Pilot/demo timing and budget committee hold

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot/demo timing and budget committee hold

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time last week. We want to get a technical walkthrough + pilot lined up so your engineers and procurement have what they need to evaluate Redwood. Tentative plan on our side is a 45–60 minute deep-dive (tech + ops) followed by a 30-minute commercial sync for procurement and finance.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Aug 27, 10:00–11:30
- Mon Aug 31, 14:00–15:30

If you expect budget gating / CFO calendar constraints this week, happy to hold both slots as tentative and move the demo to a date after your budget committee. If that’s likely, could you share the committee date so we can plan a follow-up?

Attaching a short PoC outline that maps deliverables to procurement checkpoints. If helpful, we can also do a 20-minute pre-call for the engineering team to review integration points.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:43:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot/demo timing and budget committee hold

Hi Rafael —

Thanks — appreciate the outline. A quick update from our side: our CFO (James) is out of the country for investor meetings and the finance team has a temporary spend hold while they finalize FY27 headcount and vendor commitments. The budget committee reconvenes on Wed Sep 8.

Given that, we won’t be able to move forward with procurement decisions until after Sep 8. We would prefer to schedule the demo after the committee so the commercial stakeholders can attend, but it’d be helpful if your technical folks could do a short recording or 30-minute async tech Q&A for our engineering leads in the meantime.

Tentative post-committee dates that look possible:
- Tue Sep 14, 10–11am ET
- Wed Sep 15, 1–2pm ET

I’ll confirm after the committee if either works.

Best,
Emma Carter
Head of Procurement | Acorn Health
emma.carter@acornhealth.com

Emma —

Totally understood, thanks for the color. We can do two things while you wait for Sep 8:
1) I’ll record a 20–25 minute technical walkthrough focused on integration points, inference latency expectations, and data isolation. I’ll share the recording + short FAQ.
2) We can put a tentative 1-hour slot on Sep 14 in hold (we’ll mark it "tentative - pending budget committee") so stakeholders have it on their calendars; you can drop it if needed.

Lauren/Connor — can you prep a "CFO two-pager" and a one-sheet pricing snapshot we can hand to Acorn after Sep 8? Pricing should include 30-day pilot credit options and SOW skeleton for a limited pilot.

I’ll attach the technical brief I mentioned.

Thanks,
Rafael

Raf/Connor —

Will do. Draft plan:
- Two-pager for the CFO (focus: unit economics, risk mitigation, SLA summary, pilot credit ask) — target 1 page + appendix
- Pricing snapshot (sheet) with pilot credit row and 3-month committed discount option
- SOW skeleton (deliverables, timeline, acceptance criteria)

I’ll pull the latest numbers from pricing ops and drop the files in the Deal folder. Rafael, can you share the HubSpot deal id and any specific questions James has ahead of Sep 8 so we can tailor the two-pager?

I’ll aim to share drafts by EOD Mon (Aug 31).

— Lauren
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Emma —

Thanks — we’ll hold Sep 14 as a tentative demo date and plan to finalize after your committee meets on Sep 8. In the meantime:
- I’ll send the technical walkthrough recording by Mon Aug 31 for your engineers.
- Lauren is preparing a CFO two-pager + pricing snapshot; Connor will prep a short SOW template.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACN-2389 (I’ve added a note about the spend hold and tentative dates). If James or you want a quick 10-minute pre-read with Rafael or Lauren before Sep 8, we can do that — otherwise we’ll surface the two-pager right after the committee.

Appreciate the transparency — we’ll keep everything on hold until you confirm next steps.

Best,
